title: Non-anchor position period prediction v16
rationale: This lane predeclares a position-period residue rule before scoring any new observations. It does not use public anchor-derived additive fragments, candidate words, routed key-material results, held-out anchor controls, or prior public-fragment structure screens as discovery evidence, so it is not another public-anchor mining pass.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in one or more predeclared residue classes from the registered period set before any candidate-word, key-material, route, or public-anchor-derived fragment scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: Predeclared period registry from the structural-model command family
Residue-class rule emitted before observing or scoring any new source-backed positions
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations
Observation files that declare source IDs, one-based positions, per-position notes, and rationale before evaluation
